AR.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

CA.headline: RPS 60% renewable by 2030; 100% clean electricity by 2045.

CO.headline: RPS 30% (IOUs, met); 100% clean electricity by 2050 for large utilities.

FL.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

GA.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

ID.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

IN.headline: Voluntary Clean Energy Portfolio Standard: 10% by 2025 (non-binding).

IA.headline: Legacy Alternative Energy Law: fixed 105 MW target (long since surpassed).

KS.headline: Renewable Energy Goal: 20% of peak demand by 2020 (met, non-binding).

KY.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

LA.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

ME.headline: RPS 80% by 2030; statewide target of 100% renewable electricity by 2050.

MA.headline: Class I RPS: 35% by 2030, +1%/yr after; economy-wide net-zero by 2050 (separate climate law).

MI.headline: 2023 Clean Energy Standard: 100% clean electricity by 2040.

MS.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

MO.headline: Renewable Electricity Standard: 15% by 2021 (met, static since).

NE.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

NV.headline: Binding RPS 50% by 2030; non-binding goal of 100% carbon-free by 2050.

NJ.headline: Binding RPS 50% by 2030; non-binding Energy Master Plan goal of 100% clean by 2050.

NM.headline: RPS 80% renewable by 2040; 100% zero-carbon electricity by 2045.

NY.headline: RPS 70% renewable by 2030; 100% zero-emission electricity by 2040.

NC.headline: 70% CO2 cut (from 2005) by 2030; 100% carbon-neutral electricity by 2050.

ND.headline: Renewable and Recycled Energy Objective: 10% (non-binding, 2015 target).

OR.headline: Clean Energy Targets law: 80% by 2030, 90% by 2035, 100% by 2040.

PA.headline: Alternative Energy Portfolio Standard: 18% by 2021 (static since; new CES under active debate).

RI.headline: Renewable Energy Standard: 100% by 2033 — the fastest binding deadline in the country.

SD.headline: Renewable, Recycled and Conserved Energy Objective: 10% (non-binding, 2015 target).

TN.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

TX.headline: Renewable Generation Requirement: 10,000 MW capacity goal (achieved) — actual build-out now runs far ahead of the mandate.

VT.headline: Green Mountain Power 100% renewable by 2030; remaining utilities by 2035.

VA.headline: Phased RPS: 100% renewable electricity by 2045 (Phase II utilities) / 2050 (Phase I utilities).

WA.headline: 100% GHG-neutral by 2030; 100% renewable or zero-emitting electricity by 2045.

WV.headline: Alternative and Renewable Energy Portfolio Standard repealed in 2015.

WI.headline: Renewable Portfolio Standard: 10% by 2015 (static, legacy target).

WY.headline: No RPS, CES, or clean-energy goal on the books.

DC.headline: Renewable Portfolio Standard: 20% by 2020; 100% renewable electricity by 2032.
